bodies: The American College of Financial Services

exams.name: Securities Industry Essentials Exam
exams.blurb: Entry-level FINRA exam on products, market structure, regulators and prohibited practices that can be taken without firm sponsorship.

exams.name: Series 10 General Securities Sales Supervisor Exam, General Module
exams.blurb: Second component of the sales supervisor qualification, permitting branch supervision of general securities sales activity.

exams.name: Series 14 Compliance Officer Exam
exams.blurb: Qualifies an individual to serve as compliance officer of an NYSE member firm, covering firm-wide supervisory and regulatory duties.

exams.name: Series 16 Supervisory Analyst Exam
exams.blurb: Permits an analyst to approve research reports and other public communications on equity and debt securities before publication.

exams.name: Series 22 Direct Participation Programs Limited Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Permits the sale of direct participation programme interests such as oil and gas, real estate and equipment leasing partnerships.

exams.name: Series 23 General Securities Principal Sales Supervisor Module Exam
exams.blurb: Alternative route to general securities principal registration for candidates already holding a Series 8, 9/10 or 12 qualification.

exams.name: Series 24 General Securities Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of branch activities, underwriting, trading, market making and advertising at a general securities broker-dealer.

exams.name: Series 26 Investment Company and Variable Contracts Products Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of representatives selling mutual funds, variable annuities and variable life insurance at a limited-scope firm.

exams.name: Series 27 Financial and Operations Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits a person to act as FINOP with responsibility for net capital computations, books and records and regulatory financial reporting.

exams.name: Series 28 Introducing Broker-Dealer Financial and Operations Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits FINOP duties at an introducing broker-dealer that does not hold customer funds or securities, with a narrower scope than Series 27.

exams.name: Series 39 Direct Participation Programs Limited Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of a firm whose securities business is limited to direct participation programme interests and partnerships.

exams.name: Series 4 Registered Options Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of options sales practices, account approval, communications and compliance with listed options rules.

exams.name: Series 57 Securities Trader Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Permits proprietary and principal trading of equity and convertible debt securities; replaced the former Series 55 and Series 56.

exams.name: Series 6 Investment Company and Variable Contracts Products Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Permits the sale of mutual funds, variable annuities, variable life insurance, unit investment trusts and municipal fund securities.

exams.name: Series 7 General Securities Representative Exam
exams.blurb: The general securities licence permitting sale of equities, bonds, options, packaged products and municipal securities to customers.

exams.name: Series 79 Investment Banking Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Limited registration for bankers advising on debt and equity offerings, mergers, acquisitions, restructurings and financial advisory work.

exams.name: Series 82 Private Securities Offerings Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Limited registration permitting participation in private placements of securities to accredited and institutional investors.

exams.name: Series 86 Research Analyst Exam, Analysis
exams.blurb: Analysis half of the research analyst qualification, testing valuation modelling, forecasting and financial statement analysis.

exams.name: Series 87 Research Analyst Exam, Regulatory Administration and Best Practices
exams.blurb: Regulatory half of the research analyst qualification, covering research report rules, disclosures and communication standards.

exams.name: Series 9 General Securities Sales Supervisor Exam, Options Module
exams.blurb: First component of the sales supervisor qualification, focused on supervising options sales practices at a branch office.

exams.name: Series 99 Operations Professional Exam
exams.blurb: Required of covered operations staff handling settlement, margin, stock loan, account transfers and movement of customer assets.

exams.name: Certified AML and Fraud Professional
exams.blurb: Banking certification covering BSA/AML programme management, fraud typologies, investigations, reporting and remediation.

exams.name: Certified Corporate Trust Specialist
exams.blurb: Certification for corporate trust professionals covering bond indentures, default administration, escrow and securities processing.

exams.name: Certified Enterprise Risk Professional
exams.blurb: Banking certification covering risk governance, credit, market, liquidity and non-financial risk frameworks across an institution.

exams.name: Certified Financial Marketing Professional
exams.blurb: Certification for bank marketers covering strategy, data and analytics, brand, customer experience and marketing compliance rules.

exams.name: Certified IRA Services Professional
exams.blurb: Certification covering IRA contributions, distributions, portability, required minimum distributions, reporting and plan investments.

exams.name: Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager
exams.blurb: Flagship bank compliance certification covering consumer protection law, lending regulation, deposits, BSA and compliance risk management.

exams.name: Certified Retirement Services Professional
exams.blurb: Certification for bank retirement plan staff covering qualified plan design, administration, ERISA fiduciary duties and distributions.

exams.name: Certified Securities Operations Professional
exams.blurb: Certification covering securities settlement, custody, corporate actions, income processing and operational risk in bank trust operations.

exams.name: Certified Trust and Fiduciary Advisor
exams.blurb: Wealth and trust certification covering fiduciary law, tax, investment management, financial planning and trust administration.

exams.name: Chartered Advisor in Philanthropy
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Three-course designation programme on charitable planning, family philanthropy, gift vehicles and non-profit fundraising strategy.

exams.name: Chartered Financial Consultant
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme of course-by-course examinations spanning insurance, income tax, retirement, estate and comprehensive planning.

exams.name: Chartered Leadership Fellow
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme for financial services field leaders covering recruiting, coaching, performance management and agency growth.

exams.name: Chartered Life Underwriter
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme centred on life insurance planning, policy design, business succession and estate liquidity strategies.

exams.name: Chartered Special Needs Consultant
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme on planning for families with dependants who have disabilities, covering trusts, benefits and care funding.

exams.name: Retirement Income Certified Professional
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme on retirement income strategy, Social Security claiming, Medicare, long-term care and portfolio withdrawal design.

exams.name: Tax Planning Certified Professional
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme teaching advisers to deliver tax-informed advice across accumulation, work-optional and retirement phases.

exams.name: Wealth Management Certified Professional
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Designation programme on goals-based investment planning, behavioural finance, tax-aware portfolio construction and client outcomes.
